## AnyContractCasePlugin type

Convenience type for a plugin where the specific matcher and mock types aren't known - which is the case when a plugin has been loaded dynamically.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type AnyContractCasePlugin = ContractCasePlugin<string, string, IsCaseNodeForType<string>, IsMockDescriptorForType<string>, unknown>;
```
